name: Tower Backpressure & Load Shedding
description: Enforces explicit backpressure checks and capacity polling before request dispatch, shedding excess load gracefully when rings or inference queues are saturated.
recommendations: Check channel and queue capacity (poll_ready or try_send) before enqueuing requests to prevent memory runaway.
Return explicit backpressure errors (e.g., Error::ServiceSaturated) to allow caller retry or graceful degradation.
Reject unbounded queue creation on network and IPC boundaries.
